title: What If You Stayed in Bed for 60 Days?

scenes.text: What if you stayed in bed for 60 days? Your body would act like it is in space.
NASA and ESA pay volunteers to do it, lying tilted six degrees head-down, even to eat and shower.
Within days, fluid drifts toward the head. Researchers call it puffy-head, bird-legs.
Early on, some volunteers got headaches and dizziness when turning their heads. It passed in about a week.
Over the weeks, bones lose mineral and muscles shrink. The heart pumps less blood with each beat.
Afterward comes about two weeks of recovery. Bed rest fakes weightlessness well enough to test ways to protect astronauts.
